goal: Repair the KV metadata overflow defect when a task review is registered, with offline red/green regression. No production deploy, no real review registration, no D1 operation.

defect.summary: saveTask copied the whole registry entry, including review_note and review_event.note, into the Cloudflare KV metadata object. A single real review note was therefore duplicated into metadata twice.
defect.location: worker/index.js saveTask (pre-fix: `const { task_id, dispatch_contract, dispatch_events, ...meta } = entry; put(..., { metadata: meta })`)
defect.reported_trigger: A 611-byte note, duplicated into review_note + review_event.note, already exceeded the 1024-byte serialized UTF-8 metadata limit.

fix.approach: Keep the complete original review content (review_note, review_event, review_dispatch, dispatch_contract, dispatch_events and unknown fields) in the JSON value read back by readTask. Write only a bounded projection into KV metadata.

degradation_order: shrink string fields via 128/64/32/16/8/0 byte limits
last-resort core-field projection with metadata_bounded = true
bounding_policy.non_leaking: Objects/arrays and unknown fields are never copied to metadata; the note payload is represented by booleans only.

fix.other_write_paths: recordTask now also routes its initial metadata through buildTaskMetadata so every write to TASK_REGISTRY is bounded.

consumer_enumeration.review_consumer: reviewed/review_verdict/reviewed_at plus bounded presence flags are preserved; the full review_note/review_event remains available to consumers via readTask (value).

red_evidence.observed: The KV mock recorded serialized metadata of 2773-12271 UTF-8 bytes, far above the 1024-byte bound, and review_note/review_event were present in metadata.

focused_suite.command: python -m pytest tests/test_autonomous_advancement.py tests/test_dispatch_retry_executor.py tests/test_supervisor_lineage_filter.py tests/test_status_contract_v0_2.py tests/test_submit_task_mode_passthrough.py tests/test_mark_reviewed_gate.py -q

online_evidence_boundary.observation: Both a long note and a 79-byte short note returned Internal error, and the review fields remained null.
online_evidence_boundary.interpretation: This task repairs a reproducible source-level metadata bounds defect. It does NOT confirm the online root cause and does NOT prove the online error has been fixed.

round_2.scope: Same approved 3-file BUGFIX continuation of the review-registration metadata repair.
round_2.prior_round_verification: Round 1 workflow reported the full suite passing (1688 passed, 1 skipped) and reported the metadata bound as satisfied, yet independent acceptance remained CHANGES_REQUIRED: two defects were still reproducible from the same source. This round repairs only those source-reproducible defects; it does not re-litigate round 1's recorded evidence.

R1.summary: boundTaskMetadata measured the candidate serialized bytes BEFORE appending the metadata_bounded marker, so an accepted candidate of exactly 1024 bytes became 1025 bytes once the marker was added.

R2.summary: buildTaskMetadata truncated the shared 256-byte string limit onto identity fields (project_id/root_task_id/parent_task_id), so a contract-legal longer identity was silently narrowed and listPendingResults excluded the task before reading the complete JSON value.

fix.R1: boundTaskMetadata now sets metadata_bounded and lineage_in_metadata_complete on each candidate BEFORE measuring, and the last-resort core projection is also measured against the bound. The final serialized metadata (markers included) is guaranteed <= 1024 bytes.
fix.R2: Identity fields are no longer capped by the 256-byte display limit. buildTaskMetadata records lineage_in_metadata_complete=false whenever bounding alters any identity field, and listPendingResults reads the complete JSON value back via the existing readTask(env, task_id) before applying the lineage filter, using the recovered identity for both scope matching and parent-chain resolution. No second state store is introduced; the complete record already lives in the value.
fix.unresolved_identity_handling: If a task's identity is marked incomplete and the value read-back fails, the task is retained (not silently dropped) and counted in report.lineage_unresolved, so an unknown identity is never treated as a confirmed mismatch.

red_evidence.command: git show f865895:worker/index.js > worker/index.js && python -m pytest tests/test_autonomous_advancement.py -k "r1_ or r2_" -q
red_evidence.note: The single passing case is the guard test confirming ordinary short identities still use the plain listing path; the 8 R1/R2 counterexample tests fail on the original source.

online_evidence_boundary.observation: A 79-byte note also fails online and the review fields remain null.
online_evidence_boundary.interpretation: This round repairs only reproducible source-level defects. The online root cause and the online fix effect remain unverified.
